description: Find US products by name, model, barcode or brand and category, and get offers when one product clearly matches. Supply product_id for offers on a chosen product. Set energy_star and category to check appliance efficiency; country selects US, AU or NZ. Prices exclude tax; links may be paid. Divux does not check out. Applies to product searches, store prices and ENERGY STAR appliance certification.

compact.description: Appliances: compact, mini or countertop fridges and dishwashers instead of full-size

country.description: Country for appliance ratings, e.g. AU or NZ

state.description: Appliances: two-letter US state for the yearly running cost at that state's home electricity price
